text:
naveen: Heads up team  Oxbridge RFP follow-up: procurement wants a single-page capability matrix + our RFI narrative + a clear attachments index. They also asked for POC gating criteria and 'estimated commercial path post-POC'. They want this packaged by Monday COB.

claire: For matrix, do we use the standard feature columns (Model variants, Latency SLO, Throughput, Data residency, KMS/HSM, Audit logs, SLA, Deployment mode)? Or add a 'Quantization / Perf profile' column?

garrett: Add quantization + recommended hardware per profile. Also include 'fallback model' and 'cost delta' columns. Oxbridge is explicitly asking about FIPS HSM and on-prem connectivity.

maya: Security flagged that they require KMS key separation and audit log retention 7 years. We need to call out what we capture in logs (request id, model id, token counts) vs what we redact. sec-bot: auto-note: attached template security questionnaire (security-questionnaire-oxbridge.pdf).

naveen: For POC acceptance criteria propose: 1) functional parity for 10 canonical prompts, 2) throughput >= 80% of rated QPS for 48h, 3) no P1 incidents, 4) integration with customer's KMS for key wrap/un-warp test. Thoughts?

claire: Sounds good. For the 'estimated commercial path' we'll propose: 3-month dedicated trial with commit option to 6/12 months; show committed discount tiers for 100K, 500K, 2M tokens/day. Garrett can prepare a back-of-envelope pricing.

garrett: Working on pricing. Quick ask  what's their expected tokens/day? If unsure, we'll show a range. I'll include Dedicated node estimates anchored on our A100-80GB equivalent nodes and a Private on-prem licensing estimate.

sec-bot: Uploaded: /attachments/security-questionnaire-oxbridge.pdf (uploader=sec-bot, size=145KB)

maya: Also note: if they insist on HSM in their data path we need to scope latency impact. Call out both CloudHSM and Thales/Entrust options with PKCS#11 bridge.

naveen: Let's split deliverables: 1) capability matrix spreadsheet (claire + garrett), 2) RFI narrative and attachments index (naveen + maya), 3) POC acceptance & runbook (claire + garrett), 4) security questionnaire answers (maya). Drop links here as you upload.

claire: I'll start the matrix. Will use a single-sheet condensed view + a detailed tab for notes. Posting draft by tomorrow noon.

garrett: I'll post pricing snapshot once I have node counts. ETA: 16:00.

naveen: Thanks. If legal or security raises blockers escalate asap. And ping me if oxbridge pushes to a compressed timeline.
